subject: Eval kickoff / trial plan & next steps

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: evaluation kickoff & next steps

Hi Samuel / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand ACME's priorities around ingestion speed and hallucination reduction for customer support summaries. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Success criteria we heard: 1) extractive summarization matching current human F1 >= 0.84 on 1000-sample prompt set; 2) tail latency p95 < 800ms for 2k-token requests; 3) operating cost target < $0.03/token overall.
- Proposed evaluation: 2-week trial with a small dataset (500 representative threads) + a prompt set we’ll run through Redwood Optimize.

Can we schedule an evaluation kickoff next week (30–45m) to align on trial plan, success criteria, and hand off the prompt set? Here are some times I have available:
- Tue 2026-05-12, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-05-13, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-05-14, 09:00–10:00 PT

Or feel free to pick via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/rachel-redwood/30min

I’ve attached a short trial plan and a template for the prompt set. If you confirm a slot I’ll invite Connor (engineer) for the technical deep dive and Marissa for success-metrics & rollout ops.

Attachments: redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf, acme-prompt-set.csv

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Rachel Kim
